title: GRSE Q2 profit up 12% to ₹172 crore

timeline.title: GRSE Q2 profit up 12% to ₹172 crore
timeline.line: Garden Reach Shipbuilders' revenue was about ₹1,827 crore; shares rose over 3%
more: Net profit was ₹171.98 crore against ₹153.79 crore a year ago
EBITDA rose about 25% as margins expanded
Half-year profit grew about 26%, one report said
